task.question: What title did the Lynx clinch?
task.evidence: Fowles answered the call. She racked up 17 points and broke her own WNBA rebounds record with 20. Her effort was matched by that of Maya Moore, with 18 points and 10 rebounds; Lindsay Whalen, who had 17 points and eight assists; and Seimone Augustus, who added another 14 points, six assists and six rebounds. The Lynx showed out , clinching the franchise’s fourth title, with Fowles named finals MVP.

What title did the Lynx clinch?

[Minnesota Lynx] The Minnesota Lynx are an American professional basketball team based in Minneapolis. The Lynx compete in the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) as a member of the Western Conference. The team won the WNBA title in 2011, 2013, 2015, and 2017. Founded prior to the 1999 season, the team was owned by Glen Taylor, who was also the majority owner of the Lynx's NBA counterpart, the Minnesota Timberwolves, from 1999 to 2025. The current owners of the Lynx are Alex Rodriguez and Marc Lore. The franchise has been home to players such as Katie Smith, Seimone Augustus, Minnesota native Lindsay Whalen, Maya Moore, Rebekkah Brunson, and Sylvia Fowles. The Lynx have qualified for the WNBA playoffs in 15 of their 26 years.

The Minnesota Lynx clinched the WNBA title in 2011, 2013, 2015, and 2017. 

FINAL: WNBA title in 2011, 2013, 2015, and 2017.
